task: One manual public standard Ubuntu 24.04 run, Python 3.12, one job, one thread, 15 minute job timeout
state: H2 two-electron singlet S=0, no ECP, real Coulomb AO integrals; fixed nuclei, nonrelativistic
solver: FCI in full finite orbital space; overlap-eigenvector orthogonalized AO representation, cross-check at 1.4011 bohr via RHF orbitals and direct_spin1 FCI
curve: All 16 prebound reference distances; no post-outcome removal of points
equilibrium: Bounded minimization 1.3 to 1.5 bohr, plus two local three-point parabola step sizes to diagnose location sensitivity
De: Primary: 2 E_H(same basis) - min E_H2(same basis); also report -1-min E_H2 as exact-asymptote mixed-basis diagnostic. Do not label either experimental D0.
physics_reporting: Compare every reference point, convergence differences at matched geometries, De and Re across bases. Finite-basis FCI is not CBS; no guaranteed monotonicity or rigorous error bound inferred from cardinal labels.
diagnostic_not_redefinition: The 1 mEh and 1 microEh checks are reported separately; no high-precision PASS is inherited from program/numerical PASS.
no_retries: Exactly one workflow dispatch; numerical tolerance/representation checks inside this run are specified validation, not workflow reruns
storage: No Actions upload-artifact, no cache, no Packages/LFS. Results encoded in ordinary logs, retrieved and committed as small normal public Git files. No secrets or private project material.
claim_ceiling: Reproduction of finite-basis H2 BO physics only, not atomic hydrogen storage, X, original discovery or production capability qualification
